tagline: Photograph a leaf and learn the disease and the government-approved medicine in your language
takePhotoTitle: Take a photo of the sick leaf
photoTip: Come close so one leaf fills the picture, in daylight, not in shade.
holdToSpeak: Press and hold this button, then speak about the problem
speakOptional: You can also tell us what you see. This is optional.
listening: We are listening. Let go of the button when you finish.
transcribing: We are writing down what you said
micDenied: The microphone is off. You can still check with only the photo.
working: We are looking at your leaf
askTitle: A few questions to be sure
askSub: Look closely at the leaf and answer.
unsureTitle: We are not sure what this is
unsureBody: We would rather tell you that than guess. Take a clearer photo of one sick leaf, or call the Kisan Call Centre for free advice.
blurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone still and tap the leaf on the screen to focus.
notPlant: We could not see a crop leaf in this photo.
tooFar: The leaf is too far away. Come closer.
otherCrop: This photo looks like a different crop from the one you chose.
kccFree: Free call, in your language, 6 am to 10 pm
sureLow: This is our best guess, so check the signs below
healthyBody: We did not see signs of disease in this photo. Keep watching the crop and check again if spots appear.
chemicalsNote: Approved by the Government of India for this crop and this disease. Use one product at a time and follow the label.
unitUnknown: The government list does not print the unit here. Check the label for grams or ml.
waitBefore: Days to wait after spraying before harvest
waitUnknown: Waiting period is not given in the list
hazardHigh: Highly hazardous. Wear gloves, a mask and full clothes, and keep children and animals away.
noChemicals: The government list has no chemical registered for this disease on this crop.
secWeather: Is it a good time to spray?
sprayOk: Good time to spray. No rain is expected in the next 24 hours and the wind is light.
sprayRain: Do not spray today. Rain is expected in the next 24 hours and would wash the spray off.
sprayWind: Do not spray now. The wind is strong and would carry the spray away.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
offline: No internet connection. Please try again when you have signal.
notBetter: Not better in a week? Call the Kisan Call Centre.
sampleData: Sample data for testing, not real advice
legalNote: The government lists are for guidance and not for legal purposes. Always follow the label on the product.
asPrinted: As printed in the government list
fromWords: Our answer comes from your words too
noApproved: No pesticide is approved in India for this problem on this crop. Use the practices below.
virusNote: There is no medicine that cures a virus. The approved sprays below control the insect that spreads it.
trySample: No sick leaf nearby? Try a sample photo
sampleNote: Real labelled leaf photos from public datasets, for trying Pairu.
checkingMedicines: Checking the medicines approved for this crop
stillLooking: Still looking closely, a few more seconds
offlineCheck: You are offline. Pairu opens without internet, but checking a leaf needs a connection.
checkLabelDose: We could not check this dose against the government data. Read the dose on the product label before use.
s_rice_blast: Paddy, blurry photo (shows the not-sure path)
rateLimited: Too many checks from this phone in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
checkWeather: Check spray weather for my area
pickDistrict: Or choose your district in Andhra Pradesh
ipmRecommended: Recommended in the government IPM package
checkedTwice: A second look checked the key signs of this disease.
keptOnPhone: Your checks are kept only on this phone.
checkAgainIn: Check again in 7 days to see if it is getting better.
dueTitle: It has been a week. How is the crop now?
outcomeSaved: Thank you. Saved on this phone.
dueBanner: A week has passed since your last check. Is the crop better?
describeInstead: No good photo? Describe the signs instead
describeTitle: What do you see on the crop?
describeSub: Tap every sign you see. A photo is more reliable than a description, so take one when you can.
speakSigns: Press and hold, then say what you see
fromDescription: Worked out from the signs you chose
photoMoreReliable: A photo is more reliable. Take one when you can.
talkKvk: Talk to your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)
noKvkFound: We do not have a KVK listed for this district yet.
pickDistrictKvk: Choose your district to see the nearest KVK.
nearestKvkOther: There is no KVK in your district. This is the nearest one.
doseDiffers: Dose differs by use. Read the label
treatTuber: For seed tuber treatment, as printed
treatNursery: For nursery or seedling treatment, as printed
unitNotPrinted: The government list prints no unit for this dose. Read the dose on the product label.
aiReviewed: The Telugu text was checked by an AI model against a farming glossary. It has not yet been reviewed by an agronomist.
noVoice: This phone has no voice for your language. Please read the advice on the screen.
voiceFailed: The voice could not play. Please read the advice on the screen.
micUnsupported: Speaking is not available on this phone. Tap the signs instead.
machineTranslated: This advice was translated by a computer from English. Some words may be unusual.
wk2: Comparing it with the diseases of {crop}
wk2any: Comparing it with the diseases we know
